gizmo.title: Neman kalmomi
gizmo.description: Grid na haruffa mai ɓoyayyun kalmomi. Masu koyo suna taɓa harafin farko da na ƙarshe na kowace kalma. Yana atisayen gane yadda ake rubuta kalma, ba ma'anarta ba.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Abin da ake tambayar masu koyo su samu, ana nuna shi a kai.

configure.title: Kalmomi
configure.description: Kalmomin da za a ɓoye. Ana barin sarari da alamomin rubutu a wajen grid. Kalmomin da ba su dace ba ana jera su yayin da kake gyarawa kuma ana barin su ga masu koyo.

advanced.title: Girman grid
advanced.description: Haruffa a kowane gefe, 4 zuwa 16. Bar shi babu komai don dacewa da kalma mafi tsayi (har zuwa 12). Fiye da 12 yana gungurawa gefe a waya.

advanced.title: Kalmomi a karkace
advanced.description: Ɓoye kalmomi a karkace ma. Ya fi wuya.

advanced.title: Kalmomi a baya
advanced.description: Ɓoye kalmomin da aka rubuta a baya ma. Ya fi wuya.

advanced.title: Launin ƙawa
advanced.description: Launi na zaɓi don guntun kai, harafin farko da aka zaɓa da maɓallin.
